# Dhairya International

> > Dhairya International is a manufacturer and exporter of high-purity industrial chemicals including zirconium compounds, sodium salts, chromium oxides, and pyrolysis catalysts for diverse applications.

Dhairya International specializes in bulk industrial chemical manufacturing and supply, with a strong focus on zirconium-based compounds, specialty chemicals, and high-purity powders for industrial, biomedical, and catalytic applications. The company operates as both a direct manufacturer and authorized exporter of chemical reagents and industrial supplies.
